'''House Almadar''' is a noble house in [[Arad Doman]]. King [[Alsalam Saeed Almadar]], Lord of Almadar, is the [[High Seat]] of House Almadar.

The House was one of the founding Houses of Arad Doman, as Lady [[Bastine Almadar]] co-founded the nation with Lord [[Jalaam Lazari]] and Lord [[Ahran Nawaz]] after taking [[Bandar Eban]] in c. {{fy|1096}}.<ref name="comp">[[The Wheel of Time Companion]], Arad Doman.</ref>
